Introduction

Dosie is a South Korean dancer and singer under RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”.

Prior to her debut with PURPLE KISS, Dosie participated in the idol survival show MIXNINE, where she finished in 78th place.
